feed.headline: Zelensky Says Trump Risks ‘Historic Mistake’ If He Backs Russia
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine pressed Sunday for more information on possible restrictions to Starshield, a U.S.-provided satellite internet service used by the Ukrainian military.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
feed.ai: The US president blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect.

feed.headline: Catalonia's former rebel president can return to Spain, court rules
feed.ai: The court upholds a decision to lift an arrest warrant for Carles Puigdemont linked to the independence bid he led in 2017.

feed.headline: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
feed.ai: The boss of one of Ukraine's biggest steel companies says the country has been "bundled together" in measures aimed at curbing cheap imports.

feed.headline: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
feed.ai: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto tells the BBC the US risks prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to end it.

feed.headline: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'
feed.ai: EU leaders rally around Ukraine's president after new criticism from Donald Trump, who says Zelensky is "more difficult to work with than Putin".

feed.headline: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
feed.ai: Speed curbs limited Ukraine's defences against deadly Russian attacks on Tuesday night.

feed.headline: Are student protests being manipulated ahead of France's presidential election?
feed.ai: France's prime minister has suggested that student anger is being weaponised, as the unions and other protesters prepare to take to the streets too.

feed.headline: They fled Russia, but the West sent them back
feed.ai: Over the past year there has been a stark rise in anti-government activists deported to Russia from the EU and US where they were seeking refuge.

feed.headline: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
feed.ai: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.

feed.headline: Albania’s Leader, Edi Rama, Denounces Violent Protests
feed.ai: Students upset by living and educational costs have revived protests. Prime Minister Edi Rama said they were being used by “outside forces.”

feed.headline: France in Shock After Protests Turn Into Riots, Damaging Buildings and Shops
feed.ai: After anti-government protests devolved into chaos, leaders from across the political spectrum blamed one another for the unrest, even as it largely subsided on Sunday.
